capabilities: Export a folder of notes to one PDF
Add a PDF outline and contents page
Unfold callouts in the light theme
Append linked outside notes as an appendix
extras: Desktop only; requires Obsidian 1.13.1 or newer. Uses Obsidian's built-in PDF printing (print-to-pdf IPC) and Node fs; no network access and never writes into the vault. Beta versions available via BRAT. Native TikZ 1.2.0 needed for correct light-theme TikZ output is not released yet.
problem: Obsidian can export single notes to PDF but has no built-in way to combine a whole folder into one navigable PDF.

relations.evidence: the Native TikZ plugin 1.2.0 or newer, so TikZ diagrams print in the light theme

summary: Folder exporter that combines a folder's notes into one PDF with an outline, contents page, clickable cross-references and unfolded callouts.
